verdict.rationale: GitHub docs explicitly state 'Assign initial reviews to Copilot for greater speed and quality,' directly matching the story of assigning PR review to an AI reviewer for faster turnaround. However, this is a single marketing-style doc line without deeper detail on setup, workflow, or independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the review-assignment workflow, and independent/community confirmation that Copilot-as-reviewer works well in practice.
